sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You pointed to alloy surcharges and the cost pressure behind them.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices in Germany:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own purchase history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.92; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It is a clear, fixed price and a longer term, which gives your side planning certainty without any index mechanism to administer.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you have limited room to decide this alone, we would ask you to take Option A to the person who decides on pricing. For that person, in plain words: Option A gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal a fixed unit price, a contract term that secures the business for a long period, and an order we confirm without further rounds. We are glad to provide anything your approval process needs.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As the responsible Inside Sales representative, I have reviewed your request and must decline a fixed price for a 24-month term; we will therefore proceed with your Option B including the AS-14404 index. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We can offer €5.48 for this 24-month indexed package with 60 days payment, though please note that we do not provide internal cost breakdowns.

Our current offer is a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You said that your alloy position is covered at fixed prices and that the cost pressure remains. Our options answer exactly that: with the index clause on the alloy surcharge, we carry the movement above the deadband, so your base price no longer needs a risk premium.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.06; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 3 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.03; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We know you may need sign-off beyond your own desk, so here is a short paragraph for your decision-maker. It can be approved as it stands. Could you please take Option A to the person who decides? If your pricing committee needs anything further to approve it, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
